SELECT
  (
    SELECT user_id::text
    FROM telegram_accounts
    WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS user_id,
  $2::text AS role;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $2::uuid AS user_id, $1::text AS requested_role
),
lock_attempt AS (
  SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(input.user_id::text)) AS acquired
  FROM input
),
active AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM profile_ai_sessions s
  CROSS JOIN input
  CROSS JOIN lock_attempt
  WHERE lock_attempt.acquired
    AND s.user_id = input.user_id
    AND s.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id
  LIMIT 1
),
profile_exists AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM profiles p
  CROSS JOIN input
  CROSS JOIN lock_attempt
  WHERE lock_attempt.acquired
    AND p.user_id = input.user_id
  ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id
  LIMIT 1
),
updated_user AS (
  UPDATE users u
  SET role = input.requested_role,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM input
  CROSS JOIN lock_attempt
  WHERE u.id = input.user_id
    AND lock_attempt.acquired
    AND input.requested_role IN ('man', 'woman')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profile_exists)
  RETURNING u.id, u.role
),
created_session AS (
  INSERT INTO profile_ai_sessions (
    user_id, profile_id, current_step, ai_context, status, created_at, updated_at
  )
  SELECT updated_user.id, NULL, 0, '{}'::jsonb, 'IN_PROGRESS', now(), now()
  FROM updated_user
  RETURNING id, user_id
),
accepted AS (
  SELECT
    updated_user.id::text AS user_id,
    updated_user.role,
    created_session.id::text AS session_id,
    true AS accepted
  FROM updated_user
  JOIN created_session ON created_session.user_id = updated_user.id
),
rejected AS (
  SELECT
    u.id::text AS user_id,
    u.role,
    active.id::text AS session_id,
    false AS accepted
  FROM input
  JOIN users u ON u.id = input.user_id
  LEFT JOIN active ON true
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accepted)
)
SELECT * FROM accepted
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM rejected
LIMIT 1;

),

),
profile_exists AS (

  FROM profiles p

  CROSS JOIN locked

),
inserted AS (

  )
  SELECT input.user_id, NULL, 0, '{}'::jsonb, 'IN_PROGRESS', now(), now()

)

SELECT * FROM inserted

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS telegram_id, $2::text AS file_id
),
ta AS (
  SELECT a.user_id
  FROM telegram_accounts a
  JOIN input ON input.telegram_id = a.telegram_id
  LIMIT 1
),
locked AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(ta.user_id::text))
  FROM ta
),
prof AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.user_id
  FROM profiles p
  CROSS JOIN locked
  WHERE p.user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM ta)
  ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id
  LIMIT 1
),
session AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM profile_ai_sessions s
  CROSS JOIN locked
  WHERE s.user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM ta)
    AND s.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id
  LIMIT 1
),
ins_photo AS (
  INSERT INTO profile_photos (profile_id, telegram_file_id, position)
  SELECT
    prof.id,
    input.file_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT MAX(pp.position) FROM profile_photos pp WHERE pp.profile_id = prof.id), -1) + 1
  FROM prof
  CROSS JOIN input
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM profile_photos pp
    WHERE pp.profile_id = prof.id
      AND pp.telegram_file_id = input.file_id
  )
  RETURNING id, profile_id
),
requeue_profile AS (
  UPDATE profiles p
  SET status = 'PENDING_MODERATION',
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE p.id = (SELECT profile_id FROM ins_photo)
  RETURNING p.id
),
photo_audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events (user_id, event_type, event_data)
  SELECT
    ta.user_id,
    'profile_photo_added',
    jsonb_build_object('profile_id', ins_photo.profile_id)
  FROM ta
  CROSS JOIN ins_photo
  RETURNING id
),
moderation AS (
  INSERT INTO profile_moderation (profile_id, moderator_type, status)
  SELECT ins_photo.profile_id, 'AI', 'PENDING'
  FROM ins_photo
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM profile_moderation pm
    WHERE pm.profile_id = ins_photo.profile_id
      AND pm.status = 'PENDING'
  )
  RETURNING id
),
upd_session AS (
  UPDATE profile_ai_sessions s
  SET ai_context = jsonb_set(
        COALESCE(s.ai_context, '{}'::jsonb),
        '{pending_photos}',
        (
          CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.ai_context->'pending_photos') = 'array'
              THEN s.ai_context->'pending_photos'
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
          END
        ) || jsonb_build_array(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'telegram_file_id', input.file_id,
            'position', CASE
              WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.ai_context->'pending_photos') = 'array'
                THEN jsonb_array_length(s.ai_context->'pending_photos')
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
        ),
        true
      ),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM input
  WHERE s.id = (SELECT id FROM session)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prof)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(
        CASE
          WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.ai_context->'pending_photos') = 'array'
            THEN s.ai_context->'pending_photos'
          ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END
      ) elem
      WHERE elem->>'telegram_file_id' = input.file_id
    )
  RETURNING s.id
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prof) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session) AS handled,
  (SELECT id::text FROM prof) AS profile_id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ins_photo) AS photo_inserted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upd_session) AS session_updated,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM requeue_profile) AS profile_requeued,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM moderation) AS moderation_created,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM photo_audit) AS audit_created;

SELECT
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM telegram_accounts WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint
  ) AS user_exists,
  (
    SELECT user_id::text
    FROM telegram_accounts
    WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS user_id,
  $1::bigint AS telegram_id,
  COALESCE($2::text, '') AS username;

UPDATE telegram_accounts
SET username = COALESCE($1::text, '')
WHERE telegram_id = $2::bigint
RETURNING user_id::text AS user_id, telegram_id, username;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::uuid AS user_id
),
lock_guard AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtext('wf01:start'),
    hashtext(input.user_id::text)
  ) AS acquired
  FROM input
),
recent_attempt AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM audit_events ae
  CROSS JOIN input
  CROSS JOIN lock_guard
  WHERE ae.user_id = input.user_id
    AND ae.event_type = 'start_prompt_seen'
    AND ae.created_at >= now() - interval '10 seconds'
  LIMIT 1
),
logged_attempt AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events (user_id, event_type, event_data)
  SELECT
    input.user_id,
    'start_prompt_seen',
    jsonb_build_object('responded', NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recent_attempt))
  FROM input
  CROSS JOIN lock_guard
  RETURNING COALESCE((event_data->>'responded')::boolean, false) AS responded
),
active AS (
  SELECT
    s.id::text AS session_id,
    s.current_step,
    COALESCE(s.ai_context, '{}'::jsonb) AS ai_context
  FROM profile_ai_sessions s
  CROSS JOIN input
  WHERE s.user_id = input.user_id
    AND s.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id
  LIMIT 1
),
existing_profile AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM profiles p
  CROSS JOIN input
  WHERE p.user_id = input.user_id
  ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id
  LIMIT 1
),
state AS (
  SELECT session_id, current_step, ai_context
  FROM active
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL::text AS session_id, 10 AS current_step, '{}'::jsonb AS ai_context
  FROM existing_profile
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL::text AS session_id, NULL::int AS current_step, '{}'::jsonb AS ai_context
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_profile)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  state.session_id,
  state.current_step,
  state.ai_context,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logged_attempt WHERE responded) AS should_respond
FROM state;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS telegram_id, COALESCE($2::text, '') AS username
),
locked AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(input.telegram_id)
  FROM input
),
existing AS (
  SELECT ta.user_id
  FROM telegram_accounts ta
  CROSS JOIN input
  CROSS JOIN locked
  WHERE ta.telegram_id = input.telegram_id
  LIMIT 1
),
new_user AS (
  INSERT INTO users (role)
  SELECT NULL::varchar
  FROM input
  CROSS JOIN locked
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id
),
chosen AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT user_id FROM existing),
    (SELECT id FROM new_user)
  ) AS user_id
),
upsert_account AS (
  INSERT INTO telegram_accounts (user_id, telegram_id, username)
  SELECT chosen.user_id, input.telegram_id, input.username
  FROM chosen
  CROSS JOIN input
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_id) DO UPDATE
  SET username = EXCLUDED.username
  RETURNING user_id, telegram_id, username
),
cleanup_orphan AS (
  DELETE FROM users u
  USING new_user, upsert_account
  WHERE u.id = new_user.id
    AND upsert_account.user_id <> new_user.id
  RETURNING u.id
)
SELECT
  user_id::text AS user_id,
  telegram_id,
  username,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM cleanup_orphan) AS orphan_users_removed
FROM upsert_account;

SELECT user_id::text AS user_id, telegram_id, username
FROM telegram_accounts
WHERE user_id = $1::uuid
  AND telegram_id = $2::bigint
LIMIT 1;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::uuid AS user_id
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events (user_id, event_type, event_data)
  SELECT input.user_id, 'registration', jsonb_build_object('source', 'telegram')
  FROM input
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM audit_events ae
    WHERE ae.user_id = input.user_id
      AND ae.event_type = 'registration'
  )
  RETURNING id, user_id
)
SELECT id::text AS id, user_id::text AS user_id, true AS audit_created
FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::text AS id, input.user_id::text AS user_id, false AS audit_created
FROM input
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
LIMIT 1;

WITH active AS (
  SELECT
    s.id::text AS session_id,
    s.user_id::text AS user_id,
    s.current_step,
    COALESCE(s.ai_context, '{}'::jsonb) AS ai_context,
    s.status,
    false AS profile_exists
  FROM profile_ai_sessions s
  WHERE s.user_id = $1::uuid
    AND s.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id
  LIMIT 1
),
existing_profile AS (
  SELECT p.user_id
  FROM profiles p
  WHERE p.user_id = $1::uuid
  ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT session_id, user_id, current_step, ai_context, status, profile_exists
FROM active
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NULL::text AS session_id,
  existing_profile.user_id::text AS user_id,
  10 AS current_step,
  '{}'::jsonb AS ai_context,
  'COMPLETED'::text AS status,
  true AS profile_exists
FROM existing_profile
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active)
LIMIT 1;

WITH current AS (
  SELECT id, user_id, current_step, COALESCE(ai_context, '{}'::jsonb) AS ai_context
  FROM profile_ai_sessions
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  FOR UPDATE
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE profile_ai_sessions s
  SET ai_context = jsonb_set(
        COALESCE(s.ai_context, '{}'::jsonb),
        $2::text[],
        $3::jsonb,
        true
      ),
      current_step = $4::int,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM current
  WHERE s.id = current.id
    AND current.current_step = $5::int
  RETURNING s.id, s.user_id, s.current_step,
            COALESCE(s.ai_context, '{}'::jsonb) AS ai_context
)
SELECT id::text AS id, user_id::text AS user_id, current_step, ai_context, true AS saved
FROM updated
UNION ALL
SELECT id::text AS id, user_id::text AS user_id, current_step, ai_context, false AS saved
FROM current
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
LIMIT 1;

WITH seed AS (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM profile_ai_sessions
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
),
locked AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(seed.user_id::text))
  FROM seed
),
sess AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.user_id, COALESCE(s.ai_context, '{}'::jsonb) AS ai_context
  FROM profile_ai_sessions s
  CROSS JOIN locked
  WHERE s.id = $1::uuid
    AND s.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND s.current_step >= 10
    AND NULLIF(btrim(s.ai_context->>'name'), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND (s.ai_context->>'age') ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$'
    AND (s.ai_context->>'age')::int BETWEEN 18 AND 100
    AND NULLIF(btrim(s.ai_context->>'city'), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(btrim(s.ai_context->>'description'), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND jsonb_typeof(s.ai_context->'interests') = 'array'
    AND jsonb_array_length(s.ai_context->'interests') > 0
    AND NULLIF(btrim(s.ai_context->>'purpose'), '') IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE OF s
),
existing AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM profiles p
  WHERE p.user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM sess)
  ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id
  LIMIT 1
),
updated_profile AS (
  UPDATE profiles p
  SET name = sess.ai_context->>'name',
      age = (sess.ai_context->>'age')::int,
      city = sess.ai_context->>'city',
      description = sess.ai_context->>'description',
      interests = sess.ai_context->'interests',
      preferences = (
        COALESCE(p.preferences, '{}'::jsonb)
        - ARRAY['purpose', 'hobbies', 'job', 'education', 'communication_style']::text[]
      ) || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'purpose', sess.ai_context->'purpose',
        'hobbies', sess.ai_context->'hobbies',
        'job', sess.ai_context->'job',
        'education', sess.ai_context->'education',
        'communication_style', sess.ai_context->'communication_style'
      )),
      status = 'PENDING_MODERATION',
      updated_at = now()
  FROM sess
  WHERE p.id = (SELECT id FROM existing)
  RETURNING p.id
),
inserted_profile AS (
  INSERT INTO profiles (
    user_id, status, name, age, city, description, interests, preferences
  )
  SELECT
    sess.user_id,
    'PENDING_MODERATION',
    sess.ai_context->>'name',
    (sess.ai_context->>'age')::int,
    sess.ai_context->>'city',
    sess.ai_context->>'description',
    sess.ai_context->'interests',
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'purpose', sess.ai_context->'purpose',
      'hobbies', sess.ai_context->'hobbies',
      'job', sess.ai_context->'job',
      'education', sess.ai_context->'education',
      'communication_style', sess.ai_context->'communication_style'
    ))
  FROM sess
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id
),
pid AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT id FROM updated_profile),
    (SELECT id FROM inserted_profile)
  ) AS profile_id
),
pending AS (
  SELECT
    elem->>'telegram_file_id' AS telegram_file_id,
    MIN(
      CASE
        WHEN (elem->>'position') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (elem->>'position')::int
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS pending_position
  FROM sess
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(sess.ai_context->'pending_photos') = 'array'
        THEN sess.ai_context->'pending_photos'
      ELSE '[]'::jsonb
    END
  ) elem
  WHERE NULLIF(elem->>'telegram_file_id', '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY elem->>'telegram_file_id'
),
ordered_pending AS (
  SELECT
    telegram_file_id,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY pending_position, telegram_file_id) AS ord
  FROM pending
),
photo_base AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), -1) + 1 AS start_position
  FROM profile_photos
  WHERE profile_id = (SELECT profile_id FROM pid)
),
materialized_photos AS (
  INSERT INTO profile_photos (profile_id, telegram_file_id, position)
  SELECT
    pid.profile_id,
    ordered_pending.telegram_file_id,
    photo_base.start_position + ordered_pending.ord - 1
  FROM pid
  CROSS JOIN photo_base
  CROSS JOIN ordered_pending
  WHERE pid.profile_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM profile_photos pp
      WHERE pp.profile_id = pid.profile_id
        AND pp.telegram_file_id = ordered_pending.telegram_file_id
    )
  RETURNING id
),
completed AS (
  UPDATE profile_ai_sessions s
  SET status = 'COMPLETED',
      profile_id = pid.profile_id,
      ai_context = COALESCE(s.ai_context, '{}'::jsonb) - 'pending_photos',
      updated_at = now()
  FROM pid
  WHERE s.id = $1::uuid
    AND pid.profile_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING s.id, s.user_id, s.profile_id
),
profile_audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events (user_id, event_type, event_data)
  SELECT
    completed.user_id,
    'profile_created',
    jsonb_build_object('profile_id', completed.profile_id)
  FROM completed
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM audit_events ae
    WHERE ae.event_type = 'profile_created'
      AND ae.event_data->>'profile_id' = completed.profile_id::text
  )
  RETURNING id
),
moderation AS (
  INSERT INTO profile_moderation (profile_id, moderator_type, status)
  SELECT completed.profile_id, 'AI', 'PENDING'
  FROM completed
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM profile_moderation pm
    WHERE pm.profile_id = completed.profile_id
      AND pm.status = 'PENDING'
  )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  completed.id::text AS session_id,
  completed.profile_id::text AS profile_id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM materialized_photos) AS photos_materialized,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profile_audit) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM audit_events ae
    WHERE ae.event_type = 'profile_created'
      AND ae.event_data->>'profile_id' = completed.profile_id::text
  ) AS audit_ready,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moderation) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM profile_moderation pm
    WHERE pm.profile_id = completed.profile_id
      AND pm.status = 'PENDING'
  ) AS moderation_ready
FROM completed;

SELECT s.id::text AS session_id, s.profile_id::text AS profile_id
FROM profile_ai_sessions s
WHERE s.id = $1::uuid
  AND s.profile_id = $2::uuid
  AND s.status = 'COMPLETED'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  $1::text AS profile_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM audit_events ae
    WHERE ae.event_type = 'profile_created'
      AND ae.event_data->>'profile_id' = $1::text
  );

SELECT
  $1::text AS profile_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM profile_moderation pm
    WHERE pm.profile_id = $1::uuid
      AND pm.status = 'PENDING'
  );
